preconditions: The board I2C bus used for USB PD control must already be configured.
Any external VBUS or VCONN enable path must be in a safe default state.
steps: Read the controller status registers and current PDO configuration.
Apply any project-local power-delivery contract or NVM policy.

checks: Read a status register that confirms the controller is alive.
smokeTest.passCriteria: The USB PD controller responds on I2C and returns status data.
failureNotes: A board can still enumerate the ST-LINK port even if the PD controller is unreachable.
PD contract success depends on attached partners and cabling, not only on controller presence.

highLevel.name: usbpd_read_status
highLevel.description: Read current USB PD negotiation and fault status.

highLevel.name: usbpd_set_profile
highLevel.description: Apply a selected source or provider power profile.

highLevel.name: usbpd_store_nvm
highLevel.description: Persist controller configuration when the workflow requires it.
